member.name: T:JCass_SetupLoaders.WebFolder.BudgetCategoryOverrideApplier
member.summary:
Cross-validates a parsed against the bundle's treatments sheet and the active tag's budget_data sheet, then patches the budget_category column of the treatments jcDataSet in place. Extracted from WebFolderLoader so the validation + patch logic is unit-testable without spinning up the rest of the loader.
Semantics: all-or-nothing. If any cross-validation error surfaces, the returned error list is non-empty and the treatments dataset is left untouched. Callers should log every error and abort the patch (the WebFolderLoader wires this into the existing _setupErrors + HasErrors flow).
Case sensitivity: treatment-name matching against the bundle's treatments sheet is case-sensitive (); budget-category matching against the budget sheet's column headers is also case-sensitive. Either is a locked decision in docs/web-app/budget-category-overrides-execution-plan.md.

member.summary: Validates against and ; on success patches the budget_category column of in place.
member.param: The bundle's treatments jcDataSet — must carry the treatment_name and budget_category columns (the framework's new TreatmentType(row) reads them).
The active tag's budget_<tag> sheet read into a jcDataSet. Legal categories = column headers minus period and colour, mirroring Budget.Setup.
member.returns: Empty list on success; otherwise one error per failed check. When the returned list is non-empty is unchanged.

member.name: T:JCass_SetupLoaders.WebFolder.WebFolderBudgetCategoriesReader
member.summary:
Parser for the optional per-client inputs/budget_categories.xlsx file. The reader does not validate against the bundle's treatment list or against any budget's category columns — those cross-validations live in BudgetCategoryOverrideApplier alongside the loader-side patch. This reader only enforces the file's structural contract: required sheet present, required columns present (case-sensitive header literals), no duplicate treatment_name keys, no partial-blank rows.
See docs/web-app/budget-categories-file.md for the user-facing schema.

member.name: M:JCass_SetupLoaders.WebFolder.WebFolderBudgetCategoriesReader.Read(System.String)
member.summary:
Reads the override file at .
File missing → (null, empty errors) — caller treats null as "no override; use bundle values unchanged".
File present but structurally invalid (missing sheet, missing required column, duplicate key, partial-blank row, unreadable workbook) → (null, errors). The caller logs each error and sets HasErrors; no patch is applied.
File present and valid → (set, empty errors).
Excel row numbers in error messages are 1-based to match what the user sees in Excel (header is row 1; first data row is row 2).

member.name: T:JCass_SetupLoaders.WebFolder.WebFolderBundleReader
member.summary:
Reader for the new-shape domain-model bundle file () introduced by the workbench-removal refactor (M1, see docs/web-app/workbench-removal-plan.md § 4). Author-owned content — the DLL entry-point pair plus the four DLL-bound setup sheets — is moved out of the user's setup file and into this single fixed-name file that travels with the DLL in the version zip.
This reader is additive: the old path remains in place for the old shape until the loader switchover (Step 3 of the execution plan).
Used in two places: admin upload validation (DomainModelsService.UploadVersionAsync) and — once Step 3 lands — the runtime loader. Sharing the reader avoids "valid at upload, broken at run" drift.
